name: cf-tunnel
title: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Manage Cloudflare Tunnel routes and DNS records on this host. Subcommands: config / status / list / add / del.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cloudflare Tunnel
zh-CN.description: 管理本机的 Cloudflare Tunnel 路由和 DNS 记录。子命令：config / status / list / add / del。

tools.name: cf-tunnel config
tools.prompt: 运行 cf-tunnel config 查看 Cloudflare Tunnel 配置

tools.name: cf-tunnel status
tools.prompt: 运行 cf-tunnel status 查看 tunnel 状态

tools.name: cf-tunnel list
tools.description: List all tunnel routes and DNS records
tools.prompt: 运行 cf-tunnel list 列出所有路由

tools.name: cf-tunnel add
tools.description: Add a new tunnel route with DNS record
tools.prompt: 帮我用 cf-tunnel add 添加一个新路由，请先询问端口和域名

tools.name: cf-tunnel del
tools.description: Remove a tunnel route and DNS record
tools.prompt: 帮我用 cf-tunnel del 删除一个路由，请先询问要删哪个
